title: Medical Emergency - No EMS
description: EMS is unavailable or hours away. This sequence maximizes survival for a severe trauma patient.

steps.title: Scene Safety
steps.summary: Make sure whatever caused the injury can't hurt you or anyone else

steps.title: Triage (START)
steps.summary: If multiple patients: sort by severity before treating

steps.title: Hemorrhage Control
steps.summary: Stop life-threatening bleeding - M in MARCH
checklistItems: Tourniquet applied if extremity arterial bleed
Wound packed if junctional or torso

steps.title: Airway Management
steps.summary: Keep the airway open - A in MARCH
checklistItems: Airway open (head tilt/chin lift, or jaw thrust if spine injury suspected)
Recovery position if unconscious and breathing
NPA inserted only if available and trained

steps.title: Shock and Hypothermia Prevention
steps.summary: Treat hemorrhagic shock and keep them warm - C and H in MARCH
checklistItems: Patient lying flat (do not raise the legs of a trauma patient)
Insulation under and blanket over them, even in mild weather
Breathing, pulse, and alertness rechecked every few minutes
Nothing by mouth if they are drowsy, confused, or likely to need surgery soon

steps.title: Patient Monitoring
steps.summary: Reassess every 5 minutes until help arrives
